svg.text: The participant's identity and credential service (ADR 0015), the holder side of issuance (ADR 0018) and Gaia-X onboarding (ADR 0021)
Signs self-issued ID tokens for its own
did:web document: the P-256 keys (alg ES256;
x5u with a chain) and the CredentialService
Answers a verifier's query by scope with a
Keys and signing, ID tokens, presentations,
Resolves the caller's DID and checks its
Environment variables and the key file
HTTP client, did:web resolver, API key, database
Port Directory; WebDirectory reads others' DID
documents and issuer metadata over HTTPS
CertificateChain: the PEM chain of the
identity key, checked against the key, read
Signs the legal person and terms and
stores the four credentials; at start, then
at two thirds of the validity
Asks a trusted issuer for credentials and
Since 1.4: reads the status lists of its

C4 model, level 3. The signing key never leaves this container; used token ids (jti) are kept in the identity database (ADR 0029). Gaia-X onboarding (ADR 0021) is on only with PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_URL; answers are taken only from PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_DID.
